name: TauCeti.dgCompZero_mem_dgBoundaries_of_left
TauCeti.dgCompZero_mem_dgBoundaries_of_right

name: TauCeti.dgHomotopyClass_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dgHomotopyClass_add {X Y : C} (f g : DGHom R 0 X Y)
    (hf : f ∈ dgCycles R X Y) (hg : g ∈ dgCycles R X Y) :
    dgHomotopyClass R (f + g) ((dgCycles R X Y).add_mem hf hg) =
      dgHomotopyClass R f hf + dgHomotopyClass R g hg

name: TauCeti.dgHomotopyClass_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dgHomotopyClass_eq_iff {X Y : C} {f g : DGHom R 0 X Y}

    dgHomotopyClass R f hf = dgHomotopyClass R g hg ↔
      f - g ∈ dgBoundaries R X Y

name: TauCeti.dgHomotopyClass_eq_zero_iff

theorem dgHomotopyClass_eq_zero_iff {X Y : C} {f : DGHom R 0 X Y}

statement:

theorem dgHomotopyClass_zero (X Y : C) :

name: TauCeti.dgHomotopyComp_assoc
statement:
theorem dgHomotopyComp_assoc {W X Y Z : C}
    (f : DGHomotopyClass R W X) (g : DGHomotopyClass R X Y)
    (h : DGHomotopyClass R Y Z) :
    dgHomotopyComp R W Y Z (dgHomotopyComp R W X Y f g) h =
      dgHomotopyComp R W X Z f (dgHomotopyComp R X Y Z g h)

name: TauCeti.dgHomotopyComp_dgHomotopyClass
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dgHomotopyComp_dgHomotopyClass {X Y Z : C}
    (f : DGHom R 0 X Y) (g : DGHom R 0 Y Z)
    (hf : f ∈ dgCycles R X Y) (hg : g ∈ dgCycles R Y Z) :
    dgHomotopyComp R X Y Z (dgHomotopyClass R f hf) (dgHomotopyClass R g hg) =
      dgHomotopyClass R (dgCompZero R f g) (dgCompZero_mem_dgCycles R hf hg)

name: TauCeti.exists_dgHomotopyClass_eq
statement:
theorem exists_dgHomotopyClass_eq {X Y : C} (c : DGHomotopyClass R X Y) :

name: TauCeti.mem_dgBoundaries
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_dgBoundaries {X Y : C} {f : DGHom R 0 X Y} :
    f ∈ dgBoundaries R X Y ↔
      ∃ h : DGHom R (-1) X Y, dgDifferential R (-1) h = f

name: TauCeti.mem_dgCycles
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_dgCycles {X Y : C} {f : DGHom R 0 X Y} :

name: TauCeti.smul_dgCompZero

name: TauCeti.DGRightModuleCat.dgComp_eq
statement:
@[simp↓]
theorem dgComp_eq {p q n : ℤ} (f : DGHom R p M N) (g : DGHom R q N P) (hpq : p + q = n) :
    dgHomLinearEquivCochains M P n (dgComp R f g hpq) =
      (p * q).negOnePow • dgRightModuleCochains.comp
        (dgHomLinearEquivCochains N P q g) (dgHomLinearEquivCochains M N p f) (by omega)

name: TauCeti.DGRightModuleCat.dgCycles_eq
statement:
theorem dgCycles_eq :
    dgCycles R M N = Submodule.comap (dgHomLinearEquivCochains M N 0).toLinearMap
      (LinearMap.ker (dgRightModuleCochains.differential
        (hM := M.isDGRightModule) (hN := N.isDGRightModule) 0))

name: TauCeti.DGRightModuleCat.dgDifferential_eq
statement:
@[simp↓]
theorem dgDifferential_eq (n : ℤ) (f : DGHom R n M N) :
    dgHomLinearEquivCochains M N (n + 1) (dgDifferential R n f) =
      dgRightModuleCochains.differential (hM := M.isDGRightModule) (hN := N.isDGRightModule) n
        (dgHomLinearEquivCochains M N n f)

name: TauCeti.DGRightModuleCat.dgHomComplex_eq
statement:
@[simp↓]
theorem dgHomComplex_eq :
    dgHomComplex R M N = dgRightModuleHomComplex M.isDGRightModule N.isDGRightModule

name: TauCeti.DGRightModuleCat.dgHomLinearEquivCochains_apply
statement:
theorem dgHomLinearEquivCochains_apply (n : ℤ) (f : DGHom R n M N) :
    dgHomLinearEquivCochains M N n f =
      (eqToHom (congrArg (fun K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat R) ℤ => K.X n)
        (dgHomComplex_eq M N))).hom f

name: TauCeti.DGRightModuleCat.dgId_eq
statement:
@[simp↓]
theorem dgId_eq :
    dgHomLinearEquivCochains M M 0 (dgId R M) =
      dgRightModuleCochains.id (R := R) (A := A) (ℳ := M.grading)

name: TauCeti.DGRightModuleCat.homComplexData_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homComplexData_comp {p q n : ℤ} (hpq : p + q = n)
    (f : DGHom R p M N) (g : DGHom R q N P) :
    dgHomLinearEquivCochains M P n ((homComplexData (h := h)).comp p q n hpq f g) =
      (p * q).negOnePow • dgRightModuleCochains.comp
        (dgHomLinearEquivCochains N P q g) (dgHomLinearEquivCochains M N p f) (by omega)

name: TauCeti.DGRightModuleCat.homComplexData_d_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homComplexData_d_apply (n : ℤ) (f : DGHom R n M N) :
    dgHomLinearEquivCochains M N (n + 1)
        ((((homComplexData (h := h)).hom M N).d n (n + 1)).hom f) =
      dgRightModuleCochains.differential (hM := M.isDGRightModule) (hN := N.isDGRightModule) n
        (dgHomLinearEquivCochains M N n f)

name: TauCeti.DGRightModuleCat.homComplexData_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homComplexData_hom :
    (homComplexData (h := h)).hom M N =
      dgRightModuleHomComplex M.isDGRightModule N.isDGRightModule

name: TauCeti.DGRightModuleCat.homComplexData_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homComplexData_id :
    dgHomLinearEquivCochains M M 0 ((homComplexData (h := h)).id M) =
      dgRightModuleCochains.id (R := R) (A := A) (ℳ := M.grading)

name: TauCeti.DGRightModule.RestrictScalars.val_smul_eq

    (h₁ : ∀ f : R.complex.X (n + 1) ⟶ Y, R.complex.d (n + 2) (n + 1) ≫ f = 0)
    (h₂ : ∀ g : R.complex.X n ⟶ Y, R.complex.d (n + 1) n ≫ g = 0)
    (f : R.complex.X (n + 1) ⟶ Y) :
    extLinearEquiv (k := k) R n h₁ h₂ f = R.extMk f (n + 2) rfl (h₁ f)

    (Q.isoExt n Y).hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
      ((HomologicalComplex.unopFunctor _ _).map
        ((((linearYoneda R D).obj Y).rightOp.mapHomologicalComplex _).map φ).op) n =
      (P.isoExt n Y).hom

name: TauCeti.LieAlgebra.ad_pow_apply

theorem ad_pow_apply (a b : A) (n : ℕ) :

@[simp] lemma e6SimplyConnectedRootDatum_pairing (i j : Fin 72) :

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.e6SimplyConnectedRootDatum_root
statement: @[simp] lemma e6SimplyConnectedRootDatum_root : e6SimplyConnectedRootDatum.root = e6Root

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.e6SimplyConnectedRootDatum_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp] lemma e6SimplyConnectedRootDatum_toLinearMap (x y : Fin 6 → ℤ) :

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.hasCartanType_e6SimplyConnectedRootDatum

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.mem_e6SimplyConnectedBase_support

@[simp] theorem mem_e6SimplyConnectedBase_support {k : Fin 72} :

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.pairing_e6SimpleIndex

theorem pairing_e6SimpleIndex (i j : Fin 6) :

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.root_e6SimpleIndex
statement: @[simp] theorem root_e6SimpleIndex (i : Fin 6) : e6Root (e6SimpleIndex i) = CartanMatrix.E 6 i

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.numRoots_A
statement: @[simp] lemma numRoots_A (n : ℕ) : (A n).numRoots = n * (n + 1)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.numRoots_B
statement: @[simp] lemma numRoots_B (n : ℕ) : (B n).numRoots = 2 * n ^ 2

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.numRoots_C
statement: @[simp] lemma numRoots_C (n : ℕ) : (C n).numRoots = 2 * n ^ 2

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.numRoots_D
statement: @[simp] lemma numRoots_D (n : ℕ) : (D n).numRoots = 2 * n * (n - 1)

statement: @[simp] lemma numRoots_E6 : E6.numRoots = 72

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.numRoots_E7
statement: @[simp] lemma numRoots_E7 : E7.numRoots = 126

name: Fin.partialProd_last
statement:
@[to_additive /-- The final partial sum is the sum of all the entries. -/]
theorem partialProd_last {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → M) :
    Fin.partialProd f (Fin.last n) = ∏ i, f i

name: Fin.predAbove_succ_succAbove
statement:
@[simp]
theorem predAbove_succ_succAbove {n : ℕ} (p i : Fin n) : p.predAbove (p.succ.succAbove i) = i

name: Fin.rev_finRotate_rev
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rev_finRotate_rev {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) :
    haveI

name: Fin.rev_finRotate_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rev_finRotate_symm {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) :
    haveI

name: Fin.sum_rev_castLE
statement:
theorem sum_rev_castLE (N k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ N) :
    (∑ i : Fin k, (Fin.rev (Fin.castLE hk i) : ℕ)) =
      k.choose 2 + k * (N - k)

name: Finset.sum_range_const_sub_succ
statement:
theorem sum_range_const_sub_succ (N k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ N) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.range k) (fun x => N - (x + 1)) =
      k.choose 2 + k * (N - k)

name: TauCeti.add_one_add_one_ne_self
statement:
theorem add_one_add_one_ne_self {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n) (i : Fin n) :
    i + 1 + 1 ≠ i

name: TauCeti.neg_one_pow_val_add_one
statement:
theorem neg_one_pow_val_add_one {M : Type*} [Monoid M] [HasDistribNeg M] {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (hn : Even n) (i : Fin n) : (-1 : M) ^ ((i + 1 : Fin n) : ℕ) = -(-1 : M) ^ (i : ℕ)

name: TauCeti.perm_fin_two_eq_one_or_swap
statement:
theorem perm_fin_two_eq_one_or_swap (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) :
    e = 1 ∨ e = Equiv.swap 0 1

name: TauCeti.sum_ite_val_add
statement:
theorem sum_ite_val_add {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → M) (b j : ℕ) :
    ∑ k : Fin n, (if b = (k : ℕ) + j then f k else 0)
      = if h : b - j < n ∧ j ≤ b then f ⟨b - j, h.1⟩ else 0

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.typeAIndexEquiv_symm_typeASimpleIndex
statement:
@[simp] lemma typeAIndexEquiv_symm_typeASimpleIndex (i : Fin n) :
    (typeAIndexEquiv n).symm (typeASimpleIndex n i) =
      ⟨(⟨i, by omega⟩, ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, by omega⟩), by simp [Fin.ext_iff]⟩

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.typeASimpleIndex_injective
statement: lemma typeASimpleIndex_injective : Injective (typeASimpleIndex n)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.typeASimpleIndex_val
statement: @[simp] lemma typeASimpleIndex_val (i : Fin n) : (typeASimpleIndex n i : ℕ) = i

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.IsPair.cyclicDistance_ne
statement:
lemma IsPair.cyclicDistance_ne {u v : Fin (2 * n)} (h : IsPair u v) (huv : u ≠ v) :
    cyclicDistance u v ≠ 0 ∧ cyclicDistance u v ≠ n

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.abs_rootOfPair_dotProduct_corootOfPair_le_two
TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.axis_def
statement: lemma axis_def (u : Fin (2 * n)) : axis u = if (u : ℕ) < n then (u : ℕ) else (u : ℕ) - n

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.axis_lt
statement: lemma axis_lt (u : Fin (2 * n)) : axis u < n

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.axis_opp
statement: @[simp] lemma axis_opp (u : Fin (2 * n)) : axis (opp u) = axis u

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.axis_shift_ne
statement:
lemma axis_shift_ne {u : Fin (2 * n)} {d : Fin n} (hd : (d : ℕ) ≠ 0) :
    axis (shift u d) ≠ axis u

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.coe_opp
statement:
lemma coe_opp (u : Fin (2 * n)) :
    ((opp u : Fin (2 * n)) : ℕ) = if (u : ℕ) < n then (u : ℕ) + n else (u : ℕ) - n

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.coe_shift
statement:
lemma coe_shift (u : Fin (2 * n)) (d : Fin n) :
    ((shift u d : Fin (2 * n)) : ℕ) =
      if (u : ℕ) + (d : ℕ) < 2 * n then (u : ℕ) + (d : ℕ) else (u : ℕ) + (d : ℕ) - 2 * n

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.corootIdx_def
statement:
lemma corootIdx_def (z : Fin (2 * n) × Fin n) :
    corootIdx z = corootOfPair z.1 (shift z.1 z.2)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.corootIdx_index
statement:
@[simp] lemma corootIdx_index {u v : Fin (2 * n)} (h : IsPair u v) :
    corootIdx (index u v) = corootOfPair u v

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.corootOfPair_add_self
statement:
lemma corootOfPair_add_self (u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    corootOfPair u v + corootOfPair u v = signedCoweight u + signedCoweight v

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.corootOfPair_apply
statement:
lemma corootOfPair_apply (u v : Fin (2 * n)) (k : Fin n) : corootOfPair u v k =
    if (k : ℕ) + 1 = n then (if sgn u = sgn v then sgn u else 0)
    else sgn u * (if axis u ≤ (k : ℕ) then 1 else 0) + sgn v *
      (if axis v ≤ (k : ℕ) then 1 else 0)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.corootOfPair_comm
statement: lemma corootOfPair_comm (u v : Fin (2 * n)) : corootOfPair u v = corootOfPair v u

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.corootOfPair_self
statement: @[simp] lemma corootOfPair_self (u : Fin (2 * n)) : corootOfPair u u = signedCoweight u

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.coweight_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma coweight_apply (n b : ℕ) (k : Fin n) : coweight n b k =
    (if (k : ℕ) + 1 = n then 1 else 2) * (if b ≤ (k : ℕ) then 1 else 0)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.coweight_eq_zero_of_le
statement: @[simp] lemma coweight_eq_zero_of_le {b : ℕ} (hb : n ≤ b) : coweight n b = 0

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.cyclicDistance_add_cyclicDistance
statement:
lemma cyclicDistance_add_cyclicDistance {u v : Fin (2 * n)} (h : u ≠ v) :
    cyclicDistance u v + cyclicDistance v u = 2 * n

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.cyclicDistance_eq_rank_iff
statement: lemma cyclicDistance_eq_rank_iff {u v : Fin (2 * n)} : cyclicDistance u v = n ↔ u = opp v

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.cyclicDistance_eq_zero_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma cyclicDistance_eq_zero_iff {u v : Fin (2 * n)} : cyclicDistance u v = 0 ↔ u = v

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.cyclicDistance_lt
statement: lemma cyclicDistance_lt (u v : Fin (2 * n)) : cyclicDistance u v < 2 * n

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.cyclicDistance_shift
statement:
@[simp] lemma cyclicDistance_shift (u : Fin (2 * n)) (d : Fin n) :
    cyclicDistance u (shift u d) = (d : ℕ)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.eq_or_eq_opp_of_axis_eq
statement: lemma eq_or_eq_opp_of_axis_eq {u v : Fin (2 * n)} (h : axis u = axis v) : u = v ∨ u = opp v

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.index_comm
statement: lemma index_comm {u v : Fin (2 * n)} (h : IsPair u v) : index u v = index v u

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.index_eq_of_pair_mem_iff
statement:
lemma index_eq_of_pair_mem_iff {z z' : Fin (2 * n) × Fin n}
    (h : ∀ m, (m = z.1 ∨ m = shift z.1 z.2) ↔ (m = z'.1 ∨ m = shift z'.1 z'.2)) : z = z'

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.index_shift
statement: @[simp] lemma index_shift (z : Fin (2 * n) × Fin n) : index z.1 (shift z.1 z.2) = z

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.isPair_iff
statement: lemma isPair_iff (u v : Fin (2 * n)) : IsPair u v ↔ u = v ∨ axis u ≠ axis v

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.isPair_reflMap
statement:
lemma isPair_reflMap (h : IsPair p q) {u v : Fin (2 * n)} (huv : IsPair u v) :
    IsPair (reflMap p q u) (reflMap p q v)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.isPair_shift
statement: lemma isPair_shift (u : Fin (2 * n)) (d : Fin n) : IsPair u (shift u d)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.ne_of_axis_ne
statement: lemma ne_of_axis_ne {u v : Fin (2 * n)} (h : axis u ≠ axis v) : u ≠ v

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.opp_ne_self
statement: lemma opp_ne_self (u : Fin (2 * n)) : opp u ≠ u

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.opp_opp
statement: @[simp] lemma opp_opp (u : Fin (2 * n)) : opp (opp u) = u

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.reflMap_fst
statement: lemma reflMap_fst (p q : Fin (2 * n)) : reflMap p q p = if p = q then opp p else opp q

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.reflMap_involutive
statement: lemma reflMap_involutive (h : IsPair p q) : Function.Involutive (reflMap p q)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.reflMap_of_ne
statement:
lemma reflMap_of_ne {u : Fin (2 * n)} (h1 : u ≠ p) (h2 : u ≠ q) (h3 : u ≠ opp p) (h4 : u ≠ opp q) :
    reflMap p q u = u

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.reflMap_opp
statement:
lemma reflMap_opp (h : IsPair p q) (u : Fin (2 * n)) :
    reflMap p q (opp u) = opp (reflMap p q u)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.reflMap_opp_fst
statement: lemma reflMap_opp_fst (h : opp p ≠ q) : reflMap p q (opp p) = if p = q then p else q

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.reflMap_opp_snd
statement: lemma reflMap_opp_snd (h1 : opp q ≠ p) (h2 : opp q ≠ opp p) : reflMap p q (opp q) = p

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.reflMap_snd
statement: lemma reflMap_snd (h : q ≠ p) : reflMap p q q = opp p

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.rootIdx_def
statement: lemma rootIdx_def (z : Fin (2 * n) × Fin n) : rootIdx z = rootOfPair z.1 (shift z.1 z.2)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.rootIdx_dotProduct_signedCoweight_eq_two_iff
statement:
lemma rootIdx_dotProduct_signedCoweight_eq_two_iff (z : Fin (2 * n) × Fin n) (m : Fin (2 * n)) :
    rootIdx z ⬝ᵥ signedCoweight m = 2 ↔ (m = z.1 ∨ m = shift z.1 z.2)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.rootIdx_index
statement:
@[simp] lemma rootIdx_index {u v : Fin (2 * n)} (h : IsPair u v) :
    rootIdx (index u v) = rootOfPair u v

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.rootOfPair_comm
statement: lemma rootOfPair_comm (u v : Fin (2 * n)) : rootOfPair u v = rootOfPair v u

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.rootOfPair_dotProduct_corootOfPair
statement:
lemma rootOfPair_dotProduct_corootOfPair {u v : Fin (2 * n)} (h : IsPair u v) :
    rootOfPair u v ⬝ᵥ corootOfPair u v = 2

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.rootOfPair_of_ne
statement:
@[simp] lemma rootOfPair_of_ne {u v : Fin (2 * n)} (h : u ≠ v) :
    rootOfPair u v = signedWeight u + signedWeight v

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.rootOfPair_self
statement: @[simp] lemma rootOfPair_self (u : Fin (2 * n)) : rootOfPair u u = signedWeight u

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.sgn_def
statement: lemma sgn_def (u : Fin (2 * n)) : sgn u = if (u : ℕ) < n then 1 else -1

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.sgn_eq_one_or_neg_one
statement: lemma sgn_eq_one_or_neg_one (u : Fin (2 * n)) : sgn u = 1 ∨ sgn u = -1

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.sgn_opp
statement: @[simp] lemma sgn_opp (u : Fin (2 * n)) : sgn (opp u) = -sgn u

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.shift_cyclicDistance
statement:
lemma shift_cyclicDistance {u v : Fin (2 * n)} (h : cyclicDistance u v < n) :
    shift u ⟨cyclicDistance u v, h⟩ = v

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.shift_eq_self
statement: lemma shift_eq_self {u : Fin (2 * n)} {d : Fin n} (hd : (d : ℕ) = 0) : shift u d = u

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.shift_index
statement:
lemma shift_index {u v : Fin (2 * n)} (h : IsPair u v) :
    ((index u v).1 = u ∧ shift (index u v).1 (index u v).2 = v) ∨
      ((index u v).1 = v ∧ shift (index u v).1 (index u v).2 = u)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.signedCoweight_def
statement:
lemma signedCoweight_def (u : Fin (2 * n)) :
    signedCoweight u = sgn u • coweight n (axis u)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.signedCoweight_opp
statement:
@[simp] lemma signedCoweight_opp (u : Fin (2 * n)) :
    signedCoweight (opp u) = -signedCoweight u

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.signedCoweight_reflMap
statement:
lemma signedCoweight_reflMap (h : IsPair p q) (u : Fin (2 * n)) :
    signedCoweight (reflMap p q u) =
      signedCoweight u - (rootOfPair p q ⬝ᵥ signedCoweight u) • corootOfPair p q

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.signedWeight_def
statement: lemma signedWeight_def (u : Fin (2 * n)) : signedWeight u = sgn u • weight n (axis u)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.signedWeight_dotProduct_eq_zero
statement:
lemma signedWeight_dotProduct_eq_zero {u v : Fin (2 * n)} (h1 : u ≠ v) (h2 : u ≠ opp v) :
    signedWeight u ⬝ᵥ signedCoweight v = 0

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.signedWeight_dotProduct_of_axis_ne
statement:
lemma signedWeight_dotProduct_of_axis_ne {u v : Fin (2 * n)} (h : axis u ≠ axis v) :
    signedWeight u ⬝ᵥ signedCoweight v = 0

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.signedWeight_dotProduct_self
statement:
@[simp] lemma signedWeight_dotProduct_self (u : Fin (2 * n)) :
    signedWeight u ⬝ᵥ signedCoweight u = 2

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.signedWeight_dotProduct_signedCoweight
statement:
lemma signedWeight_dotProduct_signedCoweight (u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    signedWeight u ⬝ᵥ signedCoweight v = if u = v then 2 else if u = opp v then -2 else 0

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.signedWeight_opp
statement: @[simp] lemma signedWeight_opp (u : Fin (2 * n)) : signedWeight (opp u) = -signedWeight u

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.signedWeight_reflMap
statement:
lemma signedWeight_reflMap (h : IsPair p q) (u : Fin (2 * n)) :
    signedWeight (reflMap p q u) =
      signedWeight u - (signedWeight u ⬝ᵥ corootOfPair p q) • rootOfPair p q

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.two_mul_dotProduct_corootOfPair
statement:
lemma two_mul_dotProduct_corootOfPair (u p q : Fin (2 * n)) :
    2 * (signedWeight u ⬝ᵥ corootOfPair p q) =
      signedWeight u ⬝ᵥ signedCoweight p + signedWeight u ⬝ᵥ signedCoweight q

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.two_mul_signedWeight_dotProduct_corootIdx_iff
statement:
lemma two_mul_signedWeight_dotProduct_corootIdx_iff (z : Fin (2 * n) × Fin n) (m : Fin (2 * n)) :
    (2 * (signedWeight m ⬝ᵥ corootIdx z) = 4 ∨ 2 * (signedWeight m ⬝ᵥ corootIdx z) = 2) ↔
      (m = z.1 ∨ m = shift z.1 z.2)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.two_smul_corootOfPair
statement:
lemma two_smul_corootOfPair (u v : Fin (2 * n)) :
    (2 : ℤ) • corootOfPair u v = signedCoweight u + signedCoweight v

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.weight_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma weight_apply (n a : ℕ) (k : Fin n) : weight n a k =
    (if a = (k : ℕ) then (if (k : ℕ) + 1 = n then 2 else 1) else 0) -
      (if a = (k : ℕ) + 1 ∧ (k : ℕ) + 1 < n then 1 else 0)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.weight_dotProduct_coweight
statement:
lemma weight_dotProduct_coweight {a b : ℕ} (ha : a < n) :
    weight n a ⬝ᵥ coweight n b = if a = b then 2 else 0

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeB.weight_eq_zero_of_le
statement: @[simp] lemma weight_eq_zero_of_le {a : ℕ} (ha : n ≤ a) : weight n a = 0

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.typeBSimpleIndex_injective
statement: lemma typeBSimpleIndex_injective : Injective (typeBSimpleIndex n)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.typeBSimpleIndex_val
statement: @[simp] lemma typeBSimpleIndex_val (i : Fin n) : (typeBSimpleIndex n i : ℕ) = i

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.abs_pairRoot_dotProduct_pairCoroot_le_two
TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.coweight_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma coweight_apply (n a : ℕ) (k : Fin n) :
    coweight n a k = if a ≤ (k : ℕ) then 1 else 0

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.coweight_eq_zero_of_le
statement: lemma coweight_eq_zero_of_le {a : ℕ} (ha : n ≤ a) : coweight n a = 0

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.dotProduct_pairCoroot_left
statement:
lemma dotProduct_pairCoroot_left {p q : Signed n} (h : q ≠ signedNeg p) :
    signedWeight p ⬝ᵥ pairCoroot p q = 1

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.dotProduct_pairCoroot_of_ne
statement:
lemma dotProduct_pairCoroot_of_ne {p q z : Signed n} (h1 : z ≠ p) (h2 : z ≠ q)
    (h3 : z ≠ signedNeg p) (h4 : z ≠ signedNeg q) : signedWeight z ⬝ᵥ pairCoroot p q = 0

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.dotProduct_pairCoroot_right
statement:
lemma dotProduct_pairCoroot_right {p q : Signed n} (h : q ≠ signedNeg p) :
    signedWeight q ⬝ᵥ pairCoroot p q = 1

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.eq_of_signedWeight_dotProduct_eq_one
statement:
lemma eq_of_signedWeight_dotProduct_eq_one {x y : Signed n}
    (h : signedWeight x ⬝ᵥ signedCoweight y = 1) : x = y

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.ne_signedNeg_of_ne_signedNeg
statement:
lemma ne_signedNeg_of_ne_signedNeg {x y : Signed n} (h : y ≠ signedNeg x) :
    x ≠ signedNeg y

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.one_le_dotProduct_pairCoroot_iff
statement:
lemma one_le_dotProduct_pairCoroot_iff {p q : Signed n} (h : q ≠ signedNeg p)
    (z : Signed n) :
    1 ≤ signedWeight z ⬝ᵥ pairCoroot p q ↔ (z = p ∨ z = q)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.one_le_pairRoot_dotProduct_iff
statement:
lemma one_le_pairRoot_dotProduct_iff {p q : Signed n} (h : q ≠ signedNeg p)
    (z : Signed n) :
    1 ≤ pairRoot p q ⬝ᵥ signedCoweight z ↔ (z = p ∨ z = q)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.pairCoroot_comm
statement: lemma pairCoroot_comm (x y : Signed n) : pairCoroot x y = pairCoroot y x

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.pairCoroot_of_ne
statement:
@[simp] lemma pairCoroot_of_ne {x y : Signed n} (h : x ≠ y) :
    pairCoroot x y = signedCoweight x + signedCoweight y

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.pairCoroot_reflection
statement:
lemma pairCoroot_reflection {p q : Signed n} (h : q ≠ signedNeg p) (x y : Signed n) :
    pairCoroot x y - (pairRoot p q ⬝ᵥ pairCoroot x y) • pairCoroot p q
      = pairCoroot (signedReflection p q x) (signedReflection p q y)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.pairCoroot_self
statement: @[simp] lemma pairCoroot_self (x : Signed n) : pairCoroot x x = signedCoweight x

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.pairRoot_comm
statement: lemma pairRoot_comm (x y : Signed n) : pairRoot x y = pairRoot y x

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.pairRoot_def
statement: lemma pairRoot_def (x y : Signed n) : pairRoot x y = signedWeight x + signedWeight y

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.pairRoot_dotProduct_of_ne
statement:
lemma pairRoot_dotProduct_of_ne {p q z : Signed n} (h1 : z ≠ p) (h2 : z ≠ q)
    (h3 : z ≠ signedNeg p) (h4 : z ≠ signedNeg q) : pairRoot p q ⬝ᵥ signedCoweight z = 0

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.pairRoot_dotProduct_pairCoroot_self
statement:
lemma pairRoot_dotProduct_pairCoroot_self {p q : Signed n} (h : q ≠ signedNeg p) :
    pairRoot p q ⬝ᵥ pairCoroot p q = 2

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.pairRoot_reflection
statement:
lemma pairRoot_reflection {p q : Signed n} (h : q ≠ signedNeg p) (x y : Signed n) :
    pairRoot x y - (pairRoot x y ⬝ᵥ pairCoroot p q) • pairRoot p q
      = pairRoot (signedReflection p q x) (signedReflection p q y)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedCoweight_false
statement:
@[simp] lemma signedCoweight_false (a : Fin n) :
    signedCoweight ((a, false) : Signed n) = coweight n (a : ℕ)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedCoweight_signedNeg
statement:
@[simp] lemma signedCoweight_signedNeg (x : Signed n) :
    signedCoweight (signedNeg x) = -signedCoweight x

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedCoweight_signedReflection
statement:
lemma signedCoweight_signedReflection {p q : Signed n} (h : q ≠ signedNeg p)
    (z : Signed n) :
    signedCoweight (signedReflection p q z) =
      signedCoweight z - (pairRoot p q ⬝ᵥ signedCoweight z) • pairCoroot p q

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedCoweight_true
statement:
@[simp] lemma signedCoweight_true (a : Fin n) :
    signedCoweight ((a, true) : Signed n) = -coweight n (a : ℕ)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedNeg_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma signedNeg_mk (a : Fin n) (s : Bool) :
    signedNeg ((a, s) : Signed n) = (a, !s)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedNeg_ne
statement: lemma signedNeg_ne (x : Signed n) : signedNeg x ≠ x

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedNeg_signedNeg
statement: @[simp] lemma signedNeg_signedNeg (x : Signed n) : signedNeg (signedNeg x) = x

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedReflection_injective
statement:
lemma signedReflection_injective {p q : Signed n} (h : q ≠ signedNeg p) :
    Injective (signedReflection p q)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedReflection_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma signedReflection_left (p q : Signed n) :
    signedReflection p q p = signedNeg q

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedReflection_of_ne
statement:
@[simp] lemma signedReflection_of_ne {p q z : Signed n} (h1 : z ≠ p) (h2 : z ≠ q)
    (h3 : z ≠ signedNeg p) (h4 : z ≠ signedNeg q) : signedReflection p q z = z

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedReflection_right
statement:
@[simp] lemma signedReflection_right {p q : Signed n} (h : q ≠ signedNeg p) :
    signedReflection p q q = signedNeg p

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedReflection_signedNeg
statement:
lemma signedReflection_signedNeg {p q : Signed n} (h : q ≠ signedNeg p)
    (z : Signed n) :
    signedReflection p q (signedNeg z) = signedNeg (signedReflection p q z)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedReflection_signedNeg_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma signedReflection_signedNeg_left {p q : Signed n} (h : q ≠ signedNeg p) :
    signedReflection p q (signedNeg p) = q

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedReflection_signedNeg_right
statement:
@[simp] lemma signedReflection_signedNeg_right {p q : Signed n} (h : q ≠ signedNeg p) :
    signedReflection p q (signedNeg q) = p

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedWeight_dotProduct_eq_zero
statement:
lemma signedWeight_dotProduct_eq_zero {x y : Signed n} (h : x ≠ y)
    (h' : x ≠ signedNeg y) : signedWeight x ⬝ᵥ signedCoweight y = 0

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedWeight_dotProduct_nonneg
statement:
lemma signedWeight_dotProduct_nonneg {x y : Signed n} (h : x ≠ signedNeg y) :
    0 ≤ signedWeight x ⬝ᵥ signedCoweight y

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedWeight_dotProduct_nonpos
statement:
lemma signedWeight_dotProduct_nonpos {x y : Signed n} (h : x ≠ y) :
    signedWeight x ⬝ᵥ signedCoweight y ≤ 0

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedWeight_dotProduct_self
statement:
lemma signedWeight_dotProduct_self (x : Signed n) :
    signedWeight x ⬝ᵥ signedCoweight x = 1

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedWeight_dotProduct_signedCoweight
statement:
lemma signedWeight_dotProduct_signedCoweight (x y : Signed n) :
    signedWeight x ⬝ᵥ signedCoweight y =
      if x = y then 1 else if x = signedNeg y then -1 else 0

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedWeight_false
statement:
@[simp] lemma signedWeight_false (a : Fin n) :
    signedWeight ((a, false) : Signed n) = weight n (a : ℕ)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedWeight_injective
statement: lemma signedWeight_injective : Injective (signedWeight (n := n))

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedWeight_signedNeg
statement:
@[simp] lemma signedWeight_signedNeg (x : Signed n) :
    signedWeight (signedNeg x) = -signedWeight x

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedWeight_signedReflection
statement:
lemma signedWeight_signedReflection {p q : Signed n} (h : q ≠ signedNeg p)
    (z : Signed n) :
    signedWeight (signedReflection p q z) =
      signedWeight z - (signedWeight z ⬝ᵥ pairCoroot p q) • pairRoot p q

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.signedWeight_true
statement:
@[simp] lemma signedWeight_true (a : Fin n) :
    signedWeight ((a, true) : Signed n) = -weight n (a : ℕ)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.span_range_weight_eq_top
statement:
theorem span_range_weight_eq_top (n : ℕ) :

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.weight_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma weight_apply (n a : ℕ) (k : Fin n) :
    weight n a k = (if a = (k : ℕ) then 1 else 0) - (if a = (k : ℕ) + 1 then 1 else 0)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.TypeC.weight_dotProduct_coweight
statement:
lemma weight_dotProduct_coweight {a c : ℕ} (ha : a < n) :
    weight n a ⬝ᵥ coweight n c = if a = c then 1 else 0

statement:
theorem det_cartanMatrixD_eq_det_typeDSimpleRoot_sq (hn : 4 ≤ n) :

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.linearIndependent_typeDSimpleRoot

theorem linearIndependent_typeDSimpleRoot (hn : 4 ≤ n) :

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.sum_smul_typeDSimpleRootCoordinates
statement:
theorem sum_smul_typeDSimpleRootCoordinates (hn : 4 ≤ n) (x : TypeDRoot n) :

statement:

theorem sum_typeDSimpleRoot (hn : 4 ≤ n) (i : Fin n) :

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.typeDRootReflectionEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma typeDRootReflectionEquiv_apply (u v : TypeDRoot n) :

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.typeDRootReflection_involutive

statement:
@[simp] lemma typeDRootReflection_val (u v : TypeDRoot n) :

statement: lemma typeDSimpleIndex_injective (hn : 4 ≤ n) : Injective (typeDSimpleIndex n hn)

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.typeDSimpleRootCoordinates_nonneg_or_nonpos
statement:
theorem typeDSimpleRootCoordinates_nonneg_or_nonpos (hn : 4 ≤ n) (x : TypeDRoot n) :

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.typeDSimpleRootCoordinates_typeDRootEquiv_apply_typeDSimpleIndex
statement:
@[simp] theorem typeDSimpleRootCoordinates_typeDRootEquiv_apply_typeDSimpleIndex
    (hn : 4 ≤ n) (i : Fin n) :
    typeDSimpleRootCoordinates n hn (typeDRootEquiv n hn (typeDSimpleIndex n hn i)) =
      Pi.single i 1

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.typeDSimpleRootCoordinates_typeDRootReflection
statement:
theorem typeDSimpleRootCoordinates_typeDRootReflection (hn : 4 ≤ n) (u v : TypeDRoot n) :
    typeDSimpleRootCoordinates n hn (typeDRootReflection u v) =
      typeDSimpleRootCoordinates n hn v - (v.1 ⬝ᵥ u.1) • typeDSimpleRootCoordinates n hn u

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.typeDSimpleRoot_dotProduct_typeDSimpleRoot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem typeDSimpleRoot_dotProduct_typeDSimpleRoot (hn : 4 ≤ n) (i j : Fin n) :

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.typeDSimpleRoot_mul_transpose_self
statement:
theorem typeDSimpleRoot_mul_transpose_self (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    Matrix.of (typeDSimpleRoot n hn) * Matrix.transpose (Matrix.of (typeDSimpleRoot n hn)) =
      CartanMatrix.D n

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.typeDSimpleRoot_of_add_one_lt
statement:
@[simp] theorem typeDSimpleRoot_of_add_one_lt (hn : 4 ≤ n) {i : Fin n} (hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n) :
    typeDSimpleRoot n hn i = Pi.single i 1 - Pi.single ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩ 1

name: TauCeti.DynkinType.typeDSimpleRoot_of_not_add_one_lt
statement:
@[simp] theorem typeDSimpleRoot_of_not_add_one_lt (hn : 4 ≤ n) {i : Fin n} (hi : ¬(i : ℕ) + 1 < n) :
    typeDSimpleRoot n hn i =
      Pi.single ⟨n - 2, by omega⟩ 1 + Pi.single ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩ 1

statement:
theorem eq_staircase_of_antitone_of_prefix_sum_le_of_sum_eq_of_casimir_eq
    {N : ℕ} (a : ℕ → ℤ) (ha : ∀ i, i + 1 < N → a (i + 1) ≤ a i)
    (hmajor : ∀ (k : ℕ), k < N →
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, a i) ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, ((N - (i + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ))
    (hsum : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, a i) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, ((N - (i + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ))
    (hcasimir :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, a i * (a i + (N : ℤ) - 2 * i)) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, ((N - (i + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) *
        (((N - (i + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) + (N : ℤ) - 2 * i)) :
    ∀ i, i < N → a i = ((N - (i + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)

statement:

    {N : ℕ} (a : Fin N → ℕ) (ha : Antitone a)
    (hmajor : ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k < N),
      (∑ i : Fin k, (a (Fin.castLE hk.le i) : ℤ)) ≤
        ∑ i : Fin k, ((Fin.rev (Fin.castLE hk.le i) : ℕ) : ℤ))
    (hsum : (∑ i : Fin N, (a i : ℤ)) =
      ∑ i : Fin N, ((Fin.rev i : ℕ) : ℤ))
    (hcasimir :
      (∑ i : Fin N, (a i : ℤ) * ((a i : ℤ) + (N : ℤ) - 2 * (i : ℕ))) =
        ∑ i : Fin N, ((Fin.rev i : ℕ) : ℤ) *
          (((Fin.rev i : ℕ) : ℤ) + (N : ℤ) - 2 * (i : ℕ))) :
    a = fun i => (Fin.rev i : ℕ)

name: TauCeti.toLinAlgEquiv_typeBLongRootMatrix_apply_basis
statement:
theorem toLinAlgEquiv_typeBLongRootMatrix_apply_basis {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    (bas : Module.Basis (Unit ⊕ ι ⊕ ι) K M) (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (c : Unit ⊕ ι ⊕ ι) :
    Matrix.toLinAlgEquiv bas (typeBLongRootMatrix i j hij) (bas c) =
      (if .inr (.inl j) = c then bas (.inr (.inl i)) else 0) -
        if .inr (.inr i) = c then bas (.inr (.inr j)) else 0

        Matrix.single (forkLeft n hn) (forkRight n hn) 1 -
          Matrix.single (forkRight n hn) (forkLeft n hn) 1
      Matrix.fromBlocks 0 B 0 0

name: TauCeti.TypeDStd.toLinAlgEquiv_loweringMatrix_apply_basis_of_chain
statement:
theorem toLinAlgEquiv_loweringMatrix_apply_basis_of_chain {K M : Type*} [CommRing K]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] (bas : Module.Basis (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) K M) {i : Fin n}
    (hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n) (c : Fin n ⊕ Fin n) :
    Matrix.toLinAlgEquiv bas (loweringMatrix n hn i) (bas c) =
      (if Sum.inl i = c then bas (.inl (chainNext n i hi)) else 0) -
        if Sum.inr (chainNext n i hi) = c then bas (.inr i) else 0

name: TauCeti.Sl2.dividedPower_succ_e_mul_f
statement:
theorem dividedPower_succ_e_mul_f (hef : E * F - F * E = H)
    (hhe : H * E - E * H = 2 • E) (n : ℕ) :
    dividedPower (n + 1) E * F =
      F * dividedPower (n + 1) E + (H - n) * dividedPower n E

name: TauCeti.Sl2.dividedPower_succ_f_mul_e
statement:
theorem dividedPower_succ_f_mul_e (hef : E * F - F * E = H)
    (hhf : H * F - F * H = -(2 • F)) (n : ℕ) :
    dividedPower (n + 1) F * E =
      E * dividedPower (n + 1) F - (H + n) * dividedPower n F

name: TauCeti.Sl2.dividedPower_succ_ι_e_mul_ι_f
statement:
theorem dividedPower_succ_ι_e_mul_ι_f (hef : ⁅e, f⁆ = h) (hhe : ⁅h, e⁆ = 2 • e)
    (n : ℕ) :
    dividedPower (n + 1) (ι ℚ e) * ι ℚ f =
      ι ℚ f * dividedPower (n + 1) (ι ℚ e) +
        (ι ℚ h - n) * dividedPower n (ι ℚ e)

name: TauCeti.Sl2.dividedPower_succ_ι_f_mul_ι_e
statement:
theorem dividedPower_succ_ι_f_mul_ι_e (hef : ⁅e, f⁆ = h)
    (hhf : ⁅h, f⁆ = -(2 • f))
    (n : ℕ) :
    dividedPower (n + 1) (ι ℚ f) * ι ℚ e =
      ι ℚ e * dividedPower (n + 1) (ι ℚ f) -
        (ι ℚ h + n) * dividedPower n (ι ℚ f)

name: TauCeti.Sl2.e_mul_dividedPower_succ_f
statement:
theorem e_mul_dividedPower_succ_f (hef : E * F - F * E = H)
    (hhf : H * F - F * H = -(2 • F)) (n : ℕ) :
    E * dividedPower (n + 1) F = dividedPower (n + 1) F * E + dividedPower n F * (H - n)

name: TauCeti.Sl2.e_mul_f_pow_succ
statement:
theorem e_mul_f_pow_succ (hef : E * F - F * E = H)
    (hhf : H * F - F * H = -(2 • F)) (n : ℕ) :
    E * F ^ (n + 1) = F ^ (n + 1) * E + (n + 1) • (F ^ n * (H - n))

name: TauCeti.Sl2.f_mul_dividedPower_succ_e
statement:
theorem f_mul_dividedPower_succ_e (hef : E * F - F * E = H)
    (hhe : H * E - E * H = 2 • E) (n : ℕ) :
    F * dividedPower (n + 1) E = dividedPower (n + 1) E * F - dividedPower n E * (H + n)

name: TauCeti.Sl2.f_mul_e_pow_succ
statement:
theorem f_mul_e_pow_succ (hef : E * F - F * E = H)
    (hhe : H * E - E * H = 2 • E) (n : ℕ) :
    F * E ^ (n + 1) = E ^ (n + 1) * F - (n + 1) • (E ^ n * (H + n))

name: TauCeti.Sl2.h_mul_dividedPower_e
statement:
theorem h_mul_dividedPower_e (hhe : H * E - E * H = 2 • E) (n : ℕ) :
    H * dividedPower n E = dividedPower n E * (H + 2 * (n : A))

name: TauCeti.Sl2.h_mul_dividedPower_f
statement:
theorem h_mul_dividedPower_f (hhf : H * F - F * H = -(2 • F)) (n : ℕ) :
    H * dividedPower n F = dividedPower n F * (H - 2 * (n : A))

name: TauCeti.Sl2.h_mul_e_pow
statement:
theorem h_mul_e_pow (hhe : H * E - E * H = 2 • E) (n : ℕ) :
    H * E ^ n = E ^ n * (H + 2 * (n : A))

name: TauCeti.Sl2.h_mul_f_pow
statement:
theorem h_mul_f_pow (hhf : H * F - F * H = -(2 • F)) (n : ℕ) :
    H * F ^ n = F ^ n * (H - 2 * (n : A))

name: TauCeti.Sl2.ι_e_mul_dividedPower_succ_ι_f
statement:
theorem ι_e_mul_dividedPower_succ_ι_f (hef : ⁅e, f⁆ = h) (hhf : ⁅h, f⁆ = -(2 • f))
    (n : ℕ) :
    ι ℚ e * dividedPower (n + 1) (ι ℚ f) =
      dividedPower (n + 1) (ι ℚ f) * ι ℚ e + dividedPower n (ι ℚ f) * (ι ℚ h - n)

name: TauCeti.Sl2.ι_f_mul_dividedPower_succ_ι_e
statement:
theorem ι_f_mul_dividedPower_succ_ι_e (hef : ⁅e, f⁆ = h) (hhe : ⁅h, e⁆ = 2 • e)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ι ℚ f * dividedPower (n + 1) (ι ℚ e) =
      dividedPower (n + 1) (ι ℚ e) * ι ℚ f - dividedPower n (ι ℚ e) * (ι ℚ h + n)

name: Polynomial.pow_mul_smeval_eq_smeval_mul_pow
statement:
theorem _root_.Polynomial.pow_mul_smeval_eq_smeval_mul_pow
    {R : Type v} [Semiring R] [Module R A]
    [IsScalarTower R A A]
    [SMulCommClass R A A] (p : _root_.Polynomial R) {a x c : A}
    (h : a * x = x * (a + c)) (hc : Commute c x) (n : ℕ) :
    x ^ n * _root_.Polynomial.smeval p a =
      _root_.Polynomial.smeval p (a - n • c) * x ^ n

name: Polynomial.smeval_mul_pow_eq_pow_mul_smeval
statement:
theorem _root_.Polynomial.smeval_mul_pow_eq_pow_mul_smeval
    {R : Type v} [Semiring R] [Module R A]
    [IsScalarTower R A A]
    [SMulCommClass R A A] (p : _root_.Polynomial R) {a x c : A}
    (h : a * x = x * (a + c)) (hc : Commute c x) (n : ℕ) :
    _root_.Polynomial.smeval p a * x ^ n =
      x ^ n * _root_.Polynomial.smeval p (a + n • c)

TauCeti.Associative.dividedPower_mul_ringChoose
statement:
theorem dividedPower_mul_ringChoose (m : ℕ) {a x c : A}
    (h : a * x = x * (a + c)) (hc : Commute c x) (n : ℕ) :
    dividedPower n x * Ring.choose a m =
      Ring.choose (a - n • c) m * dividedPower n x

name: TauCeti.Associative.ringChoose_mul_dividedPower
statement:
theorem ringChoose_mul_dividedPower (m : ℕ) {a x c : A}
    (h : a * x = x * (a + c)) (hc : Commute c x) (n : ℕ) :
    Ring.choose a m * dividedPower n x =
      dividedPower n x * Ring.choose (a + n • c) m

name: TauCeti.Sl2.dividedPower_e_mul_dividedPower_f
statement:
theorem dividedPower_e_mul_dividedPower_f {H E F : A}
    (hef : E * F - F * E = H) (hhe : H * E - E * H = 2 • E)
    (hhf : H * F - F * H = -(2 • F)) (m n : ℕ) :
    dividedPower m E * dividedPower n F =
      ∑ k ∈ range (min m n + 1),
        dividedPower (n - k) F *
          Ring.choose (H - (m + n : ℕ) + (2 * k : ℕ)) k *
            dividedPower (m - k) E

name: TauCeti.Sl2.dividedPower_ι_e_mul_dividedPower_ι_f
statement:
theorem dividedPower_ι_e_mul_dividedPower_ι_f (hef : ⁅e, f⁆ = h) (hhe : ⁅h, e⁆ = 2 • e)
    (hhf : ⁅h, f⁆ = -(2 • f)) (m n : ℕ) :
    dividedPower m (ι ℚ e) * dividedPower n (ι ℚ f) =
      ∑ k ∈ range (min m n + 1),
        dividedPower (n - k) (ι ℚ f) *
          Ring.choose (ι ℚ h - (m + n : ℕ) + (2 * k : ℕ)) k *
            dividedPower (m - k) (ι ℚ e)

statement:
theorem dividedPower_ι_mul_ringChoose_ι {h x : L} {z : ℤ} (hz : ⁅h, x⁆ = z • x)
    (m n : ℕ) :
    Associative.dividedPower n (_root_.UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι ℚ x) *
        Ring.choose (_root_.UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι ℚ h) m =
      Ring.choose
          (_root_.UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι ℚ h - ((n * z : ℤ) : U)) m *
        Associative.dividedPower n (_root_.UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι ℚ x)

        Associative.dividedPower n (_root_.UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι ℚ x) =
      Associative.dividedPower n (_root_.UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι ℚ x) *
        Ring.choose
          (_root_.UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι ℚ h + ((n * z : ℤ) : U)) m

statement:
theorem rootSystem_chainCoeffs_eq {a b : Weight K H L}
    (hab : LinearIndependent K ![(a : Module.Dual K H), (b : Module.Dual K H)]) :
    (rootSystem H).chainTopCoeff
        ⟨a, by
          simpa [LieSubalgebra.root, Weight.coe_toLinear_ne_zero_iff] using hab.ne_zero 0⟩
        ⟨b, by
          simpa [LieSubalgebra.root, Weight.coe_toLinear_ne_zero_iff] using hab.ne_zero 1⟩ =
      chainTopCoeff a b ∧
      (rootSystem H).chainBotCoeff
        ⟨a, by
          simpa [LieSubalgebra.root, Weight.coe_toLinear_ne_zero_iff] using hab.ne_zero 0⟩
        ⟨b, by
          simpa [LieSubalgebra.root, Weight.coe_toLinear_ne_zero_iff] using hab.ne_zero 1⟩ =
      chainBotCoeff a b

name: TauCeti.IsSl2System.structureConstant_four_term
statement:
theorem structureConstant_four_term (μ ν ρ : Weight K H L)
    (hμ : μ.IsNonZero) (hν : ν.IsNonZero) (hρ : ρ.IsNonZero)
    (hsum : (α : H → K) + β + γ + δ = 0)
    (hμαβ : (μ : H → K) = (α : H → K) + β)
    (hνβγ : (ν : H → K) = (β : H → K) + γ)
    (hργα : (ρ : H → K) = (γ : H → K) + α) :
    hx.structureConstant α β μ hμ hμαβ * hx.structureConstant γ δ (-μ) hμ.neg
          (Weight.coe_neg_eq_add_of_coe_eq_add hsum hμαβ) *
          killingForm K L (x μ) (x (-μ)) +
        hx.structureConstant β γ ν hν hνβγ * hx.structureConstant α δ (-ν) hν.neg
          (Weight.coe_neg_eq_add_of_coe_eq_add (a := (β : H → K)) (b := γ) (c := α) (d := δ)
            (by simpa only [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hsum) hνβγ) *
          killingForm K L (x ν) (x (-ν)) +
        hx.structureConstant γ α ρ hρ hργα * hx.structureConstant β δ (-ρ) hρ.neg
          (Weight.coe_neg_eq_add_of_coe_eq_add (a := (γ : H → K)) (b := α) (c := β) (d := δ)
            (by simpa only [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hsum) hργα) *
          killingForm K L (x ρ) (x (-ρ)) = 0

name: TauCeti.IsSl2System.structureConstant_four_term_invForm
statement:
theorem structureConstant_four_term_invForm (μ ν ρ : Weight K H L)
    (hμ : μ.IsNonZero) (hν : ν.IsNonZero) (hρ : ρ.IsNonZero)
    (hsum : (α : H → K) + β + γ + δ = 0)
    (hμαβ : (μ : H → K) = (α : H → K) + β)
    (hνβγ : (ν : H → K) = (β : H → K) + γ)
    (hργα : (ρ : H → K) = (γ : H → K) + α) :
    hx.structureConstant α β μ hμ hμαβ * hx.structureConstant γ δ (-μ) hμ.neg
          (Weight.coe_neg_eq_add_of_coe_eq_add hsum hμαβ) *
          (invForm (μ : Dual K H) μ)⁻¹ +
        hx.structureConstant β γ ν hν hνβγ * hx.structureConstant α δ (-ν) hν.neg
          (Weight.coe_neg_eq_add_of_coe_eq_add (a := (β : H → K)) (b := γ) (c := α) (d := δ)
            (by simpa only [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hsum) hνβγ) *
          (invForm (ν : Dual K H) ν)⁻¹ +
        hx.structureConstant γ α ρ hρ hργα * hx.structureConstant β δ (-ρ) hρ.neg
          (Weight.coe_neg_eq_add_of_coe_eq_add (a := (γ : H → K)) (b := α) (c := β) (d := δ)
            (by simpa only [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hsum) hργα) *
          (invForm (ρ : Dual K H) ρ)⁻¹ = 0

name: TauCeti.IsSl2System.structureConstant_four_term_of_rootSpace_add_eq_bot
statement:
theorem structureConstant_four_term_of_rootSpace_add_eq_bot (μ ν : Weight K H L)
    (hμ : μ.IsNonZero) (hν : ν.IsNonZero)
    (hsum : (α : H → K) + β + γ + δ = 0)
    (hμαβ : (μ : H → K) = (α : H → K) + β)
    (hνβγ : (ν : H → K) = (β : H → K) + γ)
    (hρ : rootSpace H ((γ : H → K) + α) = ⊥) :
    hx.structureConstant α β μ hμ hμαβ * hx.structureConstant γ δ (-μ) hμ.neg
          (Weight.coe_neg_eq_add_of_coe_eq_add hsum hμαβ) *
          killingForm K L (x μ) (x (-μ)) +
        hx.structureConstant β γ ν hν hνβγ * hx.structureConstant α δ (-ν) hν.neg
          (Weight.coe_neg_eq_add_of_coe_eq_add (a := (β : H → K)) (b := γ) (c := α) (d := δ)
            (by simpa only [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hsum) hνβγ) *
          killingForm K L (x ν) (x (-ν)) = 0

name: Quaternion.normSq_eq_normForm

name: QuaternionAlgebra.anisotropic_normForm_iff
statement:
theorem anisotropic_normForm_iff {K : Type*} [Field K] (c₁ c₂ c₃ : K) :
    (normForm c₁ c₂ c₃).Anisotropic ↔ ∀ x : ℍ[K,c₁,c₂,c₃], x ≠ 0 → IsUnit x

name: QuaternionAlgebra.equivalent_normForm_weightedSumSquares
statement:
theorem equivalent_normForm_weightedSumSquares :
    (normForm a 0 b).Equivalent (weightedSumSquares R ![(1 : R), -a, -b, a * b])

name: QuaternionAlgebra.equivalent_pureNormForm_weightedSumSquares
statement:
theorem equivalent_pureNormForm_weightedSumSquares :
    (pureNormForm a b).Equivalent (weightedSumSquares R ![-a, -b, a * b])

name: QuaternionAlgebra.isUnit_iff_normForm_isUnit
statement:
theorem isUnit_iff_normForm_isUnit (x : ℍ[R,c₁,c₂,c₃]) :
    IsUnit x ↔ IsUnit (normForm c₁ c₂ c₃ x)

name: QuaternionAlgebra.normFormIsometryEquivWeightedSumSquares_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normFormIsometryEquivWeightedSumSquares_apply (x : ℍ[R,a,b]) :
    normFormIsometryEquivWeightedSumSquares a b x = ![x.re, x.imI, x.imJ, x.imK]

name: QuaternionAlgebra.normFormIsometryEquivWeightedSumSquares_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normFormIsometryEquivWeightedSumSquares_symm_apply (v : Fin 4 → R) :
    (normFormIsometryEquivWeightedSumSquares a b).symm v = ⟨v 0, v 1, v 2, v 3⟩

name: QuaternionAlgebra.normForm_apply
statement: theorem normForm_apply (x : ℍ[R,c₁,c₂,c₃]) : normForm c₁ c₂ c₃ x = (x * star x).re

name: QuaternionAlgebra.normForm_apply_coordinates
statement:
theorem normForm_apply_coordinates (x : ℍ[R,c₁,c₂,c₃]) :
    normForm c₁ c₂ c₃ x = x.re ^ 2 + c₂ * x.re * x.imI - c₁ * x.imI ^ 2 - c₃ * x.imJ ^ 2
      - c₂ * c₃ * x.imJ * x.imK + c₁ * c₃ * x.imK ^ 2

name: QuaternionAlgebra.normForm_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normForm_coe (r : R) : normForm c₁ c₂ c₃ (r : ℍ[R,c₁,c₂,c₃]) = r ^ 2

name: QuaternionAlgebra.normForm_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normForm_mul (x y : ℍ[R,c₁,c₂,c₃]) :
    normForm c₁ c₂ c₃ (x * y) = normForm c₁ c₂ c₃ x * normForm c₁ c₂ c₃ y

name: QuaternionAlgebra.normForm_star
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normForm_star (x : ℍ[R,c₁,c₂,c₃]) :
    normForm c₁ c₂ c₃ (star x) = normForm c₁ c₂ c₃ x

name: QuaternionAlgebra.polar_normForm
statement:
theorem polar_normForm (x y : ℍ[R,c₁,c₂,c₃]) :
    polar (normForm c₁ c₂ c₃) x y = (x * star y + y * star x).re

name: QuaternionAlgebra.pureNormFormIsometryEquivWeightedSumSquares_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pureNormFormIsometryEquivWeightedSumSquares_apply
    (x : LinearMap.ker (reₗ a (0 : R) b)) :
    pureNormFormIsometryEquivWeightedSumSquares a b x =
      ![(x : ℍ[R,a,b]).imI, (x : ℍ[R,a,b]).imJ, (x : ℍ[R,a,b]).imK]

name: QuaternionAlgebra.pureNormFormIsometryEquivWeightedSumSquares_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pureNormFormIsometryEquivWeightedSumSquares_symm_apply (v : Fin 3 → R) :
    (pureNormFormIsometryEquivWeightedSumSquares a b).symm v =
      ⟨⟨0, v 0, v 1, v 2⟩, by simp⟩

name: QuaternionAlgebra.pureNormForm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pureNormForm_apply (x : LinearMap.ker (reₗ a (0 : R) b)) :
    pureNormForm a b x = normForm a 0 b x

name: QuaternionAlgebra.pureNormForm_apply_coordinates
statement:
theorem pureNormForm_apply_coordinates (x : LinearMap.ker (reₗ a (0 : R) b)) :
    pureNormForm a b x = -(a * (x : ℍ[R,a,b]).imI ^ 2) - b * (x : ℍ[R,a,b]).imJ ^ 2
      + a * b * (x : ℍ[R,a,b]).imK ^ 2

name: QuaternionAlgebra.self_add_star_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem self_add_star_eq_zero_iff (h2 : IsRegular (2 : R)) (x : ℍ[R,a,b]) :
    x + star x = 0 ↔ x ∈ LinearMap.ker (reₗ a (0 : R) b)

name: QuaternionAlgebra.self_mul_star
statement:
theorem self_mul_star (x : ℍ[R,c₁,c₂,c₃]) :
    x * star x = (normForm c₁ c₂ c₃ x : ℍ[R,c₁,c₂,c₃])

name: QuaternionAlgebra.star_mul_self
statement:
theorem star_mul_self (x : ℍ[R,c₁,c₂,c₃]) :
    star x * x = (normForm c₁ c₂ c₃ x : ℍ[R,c₁,c₂,c₃])

name: QuaternionAlgebra.coe_pureNormFormIsometryEquivOfAlgEquiv_apply
statement:

theorem coe_pureNormFormIsometryEquivOfAlgEquiv_apply (h2 : IsRegular (2 : R))

statement:

name: QuaternionAlgebra.equivalent_weightedSumSquares_of_algEquiv
statement:
theorem equivalent_weightedSumSquares_of_algEquiv (h2 : IsRegular (2 : R))
    (f : ℍ[R,a,b] ≃ₐ[R] ℍ[R,c,d]) :
    (weightedSumSquares R ![-a, -b, a * b]).Equivalent (weightedSumSquares R ![-c, -d, c * d])

name: QuaternionAlgebra.map_ker_reₗ_of_algEquiv
statement:
theorem map_ker_reₗ_of_algEquiv (h2 : IsRegular (2 : R)) (f : ℍ[R,a,b] ≃ₐ[R] ℍ[R,c,d]) :

name: QuaternionAlgebra.map_star_of_algEquiv
statement:
-- This cannot be a simp lemma: its left-hand side has variable head `f`, so simp cannot index it;
-- callers should rewrite with `map_star_of_algEquiv h2`.
theorem map_star_of_algEquiv (h2 : IsRegular (2 : R))
    (f : ℍ[R,c₁,c₂,c₃] ≃ₐ[R] ℍ[R,d₁,d₂,d₃]) (x : ℍ[R,c₁,c₂,c₃]) :
    f (star x) = star (f x)

name: QuaternionAlgebra.normFormIsometryEquivOfAlgEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normFormIsometryEquivOfAlgEquiv_apply (h2 : IsRegular (2 : R))
    (f : ℍ[R,c₁,c₂,c₃] ≃ₐ[R] ℍ[R,d₁,d₂,d₃]) (x : ℍ[R,c₁,c₂,c₃]) :
    normFormIsometryEquivOfAlgEquiv h2 f x = f x

name: QuaternionAlgebra.normForm_eq_of_algEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normForm_eq_of_algEquiv (h2 : IsRegular (2 : R))
    (f : ℍ[R,c₁,c₂,c₃] ≃ₐ[R] ℍ[R,d₁,d₂,d₃]) (x : ℍ[R,c₁,c₂,c₃]) :
    normForm d₁ d₂ d₃ (f x) = normForm c₁ c₂ c₃ x

name: QuaternionAlgebra.re_eq_of_algEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem re_eq_of_algEquiv (h2 : IsRegular (2 : R)) (f : ℍ[R,a,b] ≃ₐ[R] ℍ[R,c,d])
    (x : ℍ[R,a,b]) : (f x).re = x.re

name: QuaternionAlgebra.reducedTrace_eq_of_algEquiv
statement:
theorem reducedTrace_eq_of_algEquiv (h2 : IsRegular (2 : R))
    (f : ℍ[R,c₁,c₂,c₃] ≃ₐ[R] ℍ[R,d₁,d₂,d₃]) (x : ℍ[R,c₁,c₂,c₃]) :
    2 * (f x).re + d₂ * (f x).imI = 2 * x.re + c₂ * x.imI

name: QuaternionAlgebra.trace_mulLeft
statement:
theorem trace_mulLeft (x : ℍ[R,c₁,c₂,c₃]) :
    LinearMap.trace R _ (LinearMap.mulLeft R x) = 2 * (2 * x.re + c₂ * x.imI)

name: TauCeti.QuaternionAlgebra.baseChangeTwoParams_symm_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeTwoParams_symm_mk (w x y z : S) :
    (baseChangeTwoParams R S a b).symm ⟨w, x, y, z⟩ =
      w ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : ℍ[R,a,b]) + x ⊗ₜ[R] ⟨0, 1, 0, 0⟩ +
        y ⊗ₜ[R] ⟨0, 0, 1, 0⟩ + z ⊗ₜ[R] ⟨0, 0, 0, 1⟩

name: TauCeti.QuaternionAlgebra.baseChangeTwoParams_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeTwoParams_tmul (s : S) (q : ℍ[R,a,b]) :
    baseChangeTwoParams R S a b (s ⊗ₜ[R] q) =
      s • ⟨algebraMap R S q.re, algebraMap R S q.imI,
        algebraMap R S q.imJ, algebraMap R S q.imK⟩

name: TauCeti.QuaternionAlgebra.baseChange_symm_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChange_symm_mk (w x y z : S) :
    (baseChange R S a b c).symm ⟨w, x, y, z⟩ =
      w ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : ℍ[R,a,b,c]) + x ⊗ₜ[R] ⟨0, 1, 0, 0⟩ +
        y ⊗ₜ[R] ⟨0, 0, 1, 0⟩ + z ⊗ₜ[R] ⟨0, 0, 0, 1⟩

name: TauCeti.QuaternionAlgebra.baseChange_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChange_tmul (s : S) (q : ℍ[R,a,b,c]) :
    baseChange R S a b c (s ⊗ₜ[R] q) = s • map a b c (algebraMap R S) q

name: TauCeti.QuaternionAlgebra.imI_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem imI_map (a b c : R) (f : R →+* S) (q : ℍ[R,a,b,c]) :
    (map a b c f q).imI = f q.imI

name: TauCeti.QuaternionAlgebra.imJ_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem imJ_map (a b c : R) (f : R →+* S) (q : ℍ[R,a,b,c]) :
    (map a b c f q).imJ = f q.imJ

name: TauCeti.QuaternionAlgebra.imK_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem imK_map (a b c : R) (f : R →+* S) (q : ℍ[R,a,b,c]) :
    (map a b c f q).imK = f q.imK

name: TauCeti.QuaternionAlgebra.map_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_coe (a b c : R) (f : R →+* S) (r : R) :
    map a b c f (r : ℍ[R,a,b,c]) = (f r : ℍ[S,f a,f b,f c])

name: TauCeti.QuaternionAlgebra.map_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_comp {T : Type*} [CommRing T] (a b c : R) (f : R →+* S) (g : S →+* T) :
    map a b c (g.comp f) = (map (f a) (f b) (f c) g).comp (map a b c f)

name: TauCeti.QuaternionAlgebra.map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id (a b c : R) :
    map a b c (RingHom.id R) = RingHom.id ℍ[R,a,b,c]

name: TauCeti.QuaternionAlgebra.map_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_mk (a b c : R) (f : R →+* S) (w x y z : R) :
    map a b c f ⟨w, x, y, z⟩ = ⟨f w, f x, f y, f z⟩

name: TauCeti.QuaternionAlgebra.map_star
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_star (a b c : R) (f : R →+* S) (q : ℍ[R,a,b,c]) :
    map a b c f (star q) = star (map a b c f q)

name: TauCeti.QuaternionAlgebra.re_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem re_map (a b c : R) (f : R →+* S) (q : ℍ[R,a,b,c]) :
    (map a b c f q).re = f q.re

name: QuaternionAlgebra.Basis.commute_liftHom
statement:

    (hii : Commute B₁.i B₂.i) (hij : Commute B₁.i B₂.j) (hji : Commute B₁.j B₂.i)
    (hjj : Commute B₁.j B₂.j) (x : ℍ[R,c₁,c₂,c₃]) (y : ℍ[R,d₁,d₂,d₃]) :

name: TauCeti.QuaternionAlgebra.nonempty_algEquiv_of_equivalent_binary
statement:
theorem nonempty_algEquiv_of_equivalent_binary (a b c d : R)
    (h : (weightedSumSquares R ![a, b]).Equivalent
      (weightedSumSquares R ![c, d])) :
    Nonempty (ℍ[R,(a : R),(b : R)] ≃ₐ[R] ℍ[R,(c : R),(d : R)])

name: TauCeti.QuaternionAlgebra.aNegAEquivMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem aNegAEquivMatrix_apply (a : Rˣ) (x : ℍ[R,(a : R),-(a : R)]) :
    aNegAEquivMatrix a x =
      !![x.re + (a : R) * x.imK, (a : R) * (x.imI - x.imJ);
         x.imI + x.imJ, x.re - (a : R) * x.imK]

name: TauCeti.QuaternionAlgebra.aNegAEquivMatrix_apply_i
statement:
@[simp]
theorem aNegAEquivMatrix_apply_i (a : Rˣ) :
    aNegAEquivMatrix a ⟨0, 1, 0, 0⟩ = !![0, (a : R); 1, 0]

name: TauCeti.QuaternionAlgebra.aNegAEquivMatrix_apply_j
statement:
@[simp]
theorem aNegAEquivMatrix_apply_j (a : Rˣ) :
    aNegAEquivMatrix a ⟨0, 0, 1, 0⟩ = !![0, -(a : R); 1, 0]

name: TauCeti.QuaternionAlgebra.aNegAEquivMatrix_apply_k
statement:
@[simp]
theorem aNegAEquivMatrix_apply_k (a : Rˣ) :
    aNegAEquivMatrix a ⟨0, 0, 0, 1⟩ = !![(a : R), 0; 0, -(a : R)]

name: TauCeti.QuaternionAlgebra.aNegAEquivMatrix_symm_apply
statement:
theorem aNegAEquivMatrix_symm_apply (a : Rˣ) (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) :
    (aNegAEquivMatrix a).symm M =
      ⟨⅟ (2 : R) * (M 0 0 + M 1 1),
        ⅟ (2 : R) * (M 1 0 + (↑(a⁻¹) : R) * M 0 1),
        ⅟ (2 : R) * (M 1 0 - (↑(a⁻¹) : R) * M 0 1),
        ⅟ (2 : R) * ((↑(a⁻¹) : R) * (M 0 0 - M 1 1))⟩

name: TauCeti.QuaternionAlgebra.oneEquivMatrix_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem oneEquivMatrix_apply (b : Rˣ) (q : ℍ[R,1,(b : R)]) :
    oneEquivMatrix b q =
      !![q.re + q.imI, (b : R) * (q.imJ + q.imK);
        q.imJ - q.imK, q.re - q.imI]

name: TauCeti.QuaternionAlgebra.oneEquivMatrix_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem oneEquivMatrix_symm_apply (b : Rˣ) (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) :
    (oneEquivMatrix b).symm M =
      ⟨⅟(2 : R) * (M 0 0 + M 1 1),
        ⅟(2 : R) * (M 0 0 - M 1 1),
        ⅟(2 : R) * (((b⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) * M 0 1 + M 1 0),
        ⅟(2 : R) * (((b⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) * M 0 1 - M 1 0)⟩

name: TauCeti.QuaternionAlgebra.completeSquareEquiv_apply_i
statement:
@[simp]
theorem completeSquareEquiv_apply_i (a b c : R) :
    completeSquareEquiv a b c ⟨0, 1, 0, 0⟩ =
      ⟨⅟ (2 : R) * b, ⅟ (2 : R), 0, 0⟩

name: TauCeti.firstSquareEquivMatrix_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem firstSquareEquivMatrix_apply (a b : Rˣ)
    (q : QuaternionAlgebra R ((a : R) ^ 2) 0 (b : R)) :
    firstSquareEquivMatrix a b q =
      !![q.re + (a : R) * q.imI, (b : R) * q.imJ + (b : R) * (a : R) * q.imK;
        q.imJ - (a : R) * q.imK, q.re - (a : R) * q.imI]

name: TauCeti.firstSquareEquivMatrix_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem firstSquareEquivMatrix_symm_apply (a b : Rˣ) (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) :
    (firstSquareEquivMatrix a b).symm M =
      ⟨⅟(2 : R) * (M 0 0 + M 1 1),
        ⅟(2 : R) * (((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) * (M 0 0 - M 1 1)),
        ⅟(2 : R) * (((b⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) * M 0 1 + M 1 0),
        -(⅟(2 : R) * (((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) * (M 1 0 - ((b⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) * M 0 1)))⟩

name: TauCeti.secondSquareEquivMatrix_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem secondSquareEquivMatrix_apply (a b : Rˣ)
    (q : QuaternionAlgebra R (a : R) 0 ((b : R) ^ 2)) :
    secondSquareEquivMatrix a b q =
      !![q.re + (b : R) * q.imJ, (a : R) * q.imI - (a : R) * (b : R) * q.imK;
        q.imI + (b : R) * q.imK, q.re - (b : R) * q.imJ]

name: TauCeti.secondSquareEquivMatrix_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem secondSquareEquivMatrix_symm_apply (a b : Rˣ) (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) :
    (secondSquareEquivMatrix a b).symm M =
      ⟨⅟(2 : R) * (M 0 0 + M 1 1),
        ⅟(2 : R) * (((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) * M 0 1 + M 1 0),
        ⅟(2 : R) * (((b⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) * (M 0 0 - M 1 1)),
        ⅟(2 : R) * (((b⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) *
          (M 1 0 - ((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) * M 0 1))⟩

name: Subring.tensorSquareMap_injective
statement:
-- The subring is torsion-free as an abelian group because it embeds in a rational vector space,
-- hence flat over `ℤ`. Therefore tensoring its inclusion with itself is injective. The target
-- of that map is initially `A ⊗[ℤ] A`; the canonical equivalence `A ⊗[ℤ] A ≃ A ⊗[ℚ] A` then
-- gives the stated map.
theorem _root_.Subring.tensorSquareMap_injective (S : Subring A) :
    Function.Injective (Subring.tensorSquareMap ℚ S)

name: TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration.associatedGraded_of_mul_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem associatedGraded_of_mul_of {f : M →ₗ[R] A} {i j : ℕ}
    (x : GradedPiece f i) (y : GradedPiece f j) :
    (DirectSum.of (GradedPiece f) i x * DirectSum.of (GradedPiece f) j y : AssociatedGraded f) =
      DirectSum.of (GradedPiece f) (i + j) (gradedMul f i j x y)

name: TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration.gradedAlgebraMap₀_apply
statement:
theorem gradedAlgebraMap₀_apply (f : M →ₗ[R] A) (r : R) :
    gradedAlgebraMap₀ f r =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk
        (⟨algebraMap R (A) r, algebraMap_mem_wordFiltration f r 0⟩ :
          wordFiltration f 0)

name: TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration.gradedAlgebraMap₀_commutes
statement:
theorem gradedAlgebraMap₀_commutes (f : M →ₗ[R] A) (r : R) (k : ℕ)
    (x : GradedPiece f k) :
    cast (congrArg (GradedPiece f)
      ((Nat.zero_add k).trans (Nat.add_zero k).symm))
      (gradedMul f 0 k (gradedAlgebraMap₀ f r) x) =
      gradedMul f k 0 x (gradedAlgebraMap₀ f r)

name: TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration.gradedAlgebraMap₀_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradedAlgebraMap₀_mul (f : M →ₗ[R] A) (r : R) (k : ℕ)
    (x : GradedPiece f k) :
    cast (congrArg (GradedPiece f) (Nat.zero_add k))
      (gradedMul f 0 k (gradedAlgebraMap₀ f r) x) = r • x

name: TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration.gradedAlgebraMap₀_mul_algebraMap₀
statement:
@[simp 1100] theorem gradedAlgebraMap₀_mul_algebraMap₀ (f : M →ₗ[R] A) (r s : R) :
    gradedMul f 0 0 (gradedAlgebraMap₀ f r)
      (gradedAlgebraMap₀ f s) = gradedAlgebraMap₀ f (r * s)

name: TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration.gradedMul_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gradedMul_apply_mk (f : M →ₗ[R] A) (i j : ℕ) (x : wordFiltration f i)
    (y : wordFiltration f j) :
    gradedMul f i j (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) (Submodule.Quotient.mk y) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk
        (⟨(x : A) * y, mul_mem_wordFiltration f x.property y.property⟩ :
          wordFiltration f (i + j))

name: TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration.gradedMul_assoc
statement:
theorem gradedMul_assoc (f : M →ₗ[R] A) (i j k : ℕ)
    (x : GradedPiece f i) (y : GradedPiece f j)
    (z : GradedPiece f k) :
    cast (congrArg (GradedPiece f) (Nat.add_assoc i j k))
      (gradedMul f (i + j) k (gradedMul f i j x y) z) =
      gradedMul f i (j + k) x (gradedMul f j k y z)

name: TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration.gradedMul_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradedMul_one (f : M →ₗ[R] A) (k : ℕ)
    (x : GradedPiece f k) :
    gradedMul f k 0 x (gradedOne f) =
      cast (congrArg (GradedPiece f) (Nat.add_zero k).symm) x

statement:

name: TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration.gradedOne_mul

    (x : GradedPiece f k) :

name: TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration.gradedPiece_cast_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gradedPiece_cast_mk (f : M →ₗ[R] A) {i j : ℕ}
    (h : i = j) (x : wordFiltration f i) :
    cast (congrArg (GradedPiece f) h) (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (cast (congrArg (fun k => ↥(wordFiltration f k)) h) x)

name: TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration.gradedPiece_induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem gradedPiece_induction_on (f : M →ₗ[R] A) {k : ℕ}
    {motive : GradedPiece f k → Prop} (x : GradedPiece f k)
    (word : ∀ (l : List M) (hl : l.length = k),
      motive (Submodule.Quotient.mk
        (⟨(l.map f).prod, prod_map_mem_wordFiltration f hl.le⟩ : wordFiltration f k)))
    (zero : motive 0) (add : ∀ x y, motive x → motive y → motive (x + y))
    (smul : ∀ (r : R) x, motive x → motive (r • x)) : motive x

name: TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration.gradedPiece_induction_on_of_span
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem gradedPiece_induction_on_of_span (f : M →ₗ[R] A) {ι : Type*} (e : ι → M)
    (he : Submodule.span R (Set.range e) = ⊤) {k : ℕ}
    {motive : GradedPiece f k → Prop} (x : GradedPiece f k)
    (word : ∀ (l : List ι) (hl : l.length = k),
      motive (Submodule.Quotient.mk
        (⟨(l.map fun i ↦ f (e i)).prod, by
          simpa only [List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using
            prod_map_mem_wordFiltration f (l := l.map e) (by simpa using hl.le)⟩ :
          wordFiltration f k)))
    (zero : motive 0) (add : ∀ x y, motive x → motive y → motive (x + y))
    (smul : ∀ (r : R) x, motive x → motive (r • x)) : motive x

name: TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration.gradedPiece_mk_prod_map_eq_zero_of_length_lt
statement:

theorem gradedPiece_mk_prod_map_eq_zero_of_length_lt (f : M →ₗ[R] A) {k : ℕ} {l : List M}
