name: FractionalIdeal.count_div
statement:
theorem count_div {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsDedekindDomain A] (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra A K]
    [IsFractionRing A K] (w : HeightOneSpectrum A) {I J : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K} (hI : I ≠ 0)
    (hJ : J ≠ 0) : count K w (I / J) = count K w I - count K w J

name: FractionalIdeal.count_spanSingleton_div
statement:
theorem count_spanSingleton_div {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsDedekindDomain A] (K : Type*) [Field K]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] (w : HeightOneSpectrum A) {x y : K} (hx : x ≠ 0)
    (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    count K w (spanSingleton A⁰ (x / y)) =
      count K w (spanSingleton A⁰ x) - count K w (spanSingleton A⁰ y)

name: FractionalIdeal.finprod_unitOfPrime_zpow_count
statement:
lemma finprod_unitOfPrime_zpow_count (I : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) :
    I = ∏ᶠ v : HeightOneSpectrum R,
      v.unitOfPrime K ^ count K v (I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)

name: FractionalIdeal.hasFiniteMulSupport_unitOfPrime_zpow
statement:
lemma hasFiniteMulSupport_unitOfPrime_zpow (I : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) :
    (Function.mulSupport fun v : HeightOneSpectrum R ↦
      v.unitOfPrime K ^ count K v (I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)).Finite

name: FractionalIdeal.hasFiniteMulSupport_zpow_count
statement:
lemma hasFiniteMulSupport_zpow_count {G : Type*} [DivInvMonoid G] (I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)
    (f : HeightOneSpectrum R → G) :
    (Function.mulSupport fun v : HeightOneSpectrum R ↦ f v ^ count K v I).Finite

name: Ideal.hasFiniteMulSupport_asIdeal_pow_of_le_count
statement:
theorem hasFiniteMulSupport_asIdeal_pow_of_le_count {I : Ideal R} (hI : I ≠ 0)
    (e : HeightOneSpectrum R → ℕ)
    (he : ∀ v, e v ≤ (Associates.mk v.asIdeal).count (Associates.mk I).factors) :
    Function.HasFiniteMulSupport fun v : HeightOneSpectrum R => v.asIdeal ^ e v

name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.coe_unitOfPrime
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_unitOfPrime (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra R K]
  [IsFractionRing R K] :
    (v.unitOfPrime K : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) = v.asIdeal

name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.le_count_associates_iff_le_pow
statement:
theorem le_count_associates_iff_le_pow {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsDedekindDomain A]
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum A) {J : Ideal A} (hJ : J ≠ ⊥) (k : ℕ) :
    k ≤ (Associates.mk v.asIdeal).count (Associates.mk J).factors ↔ J ≤ v.asIdeal ^ k

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain_ord
statement:
@[simp]
lemma OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain_ord (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    (OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).ord v = adicOrd R K v

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.adicOrd_eq_fractionalIdeal_count
statement:
lemma adicOrd_eq_fractionalIdeal_count (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) (u : Additive Kˣ) :
    adicOrd R K v u =
      FractionalIdeal.count K v
        (toPrincipalIdeal R K (Additive.toMul u) : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_principalDivisor_eq_fractionalIdeal_count
statement:
lemma coeff_principalDivisor_eq_fractionalIdeal_count (u : Additive Kˣ) (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    coeff ((OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).principalDivisor u) v =
      FractionalIdeal.count K v
        (toPrincipalIdeal R K (Additive.toMul u) : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_principalDivisor_pos_iff_mem
statement:
lemma coeff_principalDivisor_pos_iff_mem {r : R} {u : Kˣ} (hu : (u : K) = algebraMap R K r)
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    0 < coeff ((OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).principalDivisor (Additive.ofMul u)) v ↔
      r ∈ v.asIdeal

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.isEffective_principalDivisor_of_integral
statement:
lemma isEffective_principalDivisor_of_integral {r : R} {u : Kˣ} (hu : (u : K) = algebraMap R K r) :
    IsEffective ((OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).principalDivisor (Additive.ofMul u))

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.mem_support_principalDivisor_of_integral_iff_mem_asIdeal
statement:
lemma mem_support_principalDivisor_of_integral_iff_mem_asIdeal {r : R} {u : Kˣ}
    (hu : (u : K) = algebraMap R K r) (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    v ∈ ((OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).principalDivisor (Additive.ofMul u)).support ↔
      r ∈ v.asIdeal

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coeff_fractionalIdealDivisor
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coeff_fractionalIdealDivisor (I : Additive (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ)
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    coeff (fractionalIdealDivisor R K I) v =
      FractionalIdeal.count K v (Units.val (Additive.toMul I))

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_apply (I : Additive (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) :
    fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv R K I = fractionalIdealDivisor R K I

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_symm_apply (D : WeilDivisor (HeightOneSpectrum R)) :
    (fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv R K).symm D =
      Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 (D.prod fun v e => (v.asIdeal : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) ^ e)
        (prod_asIdeal_zpow_ne_zero R K D))

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_toPrincipalIdeal
statement:
lemma fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_toPrincipalIdeal (x : Kˣ) :
    fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv R K (Additive.ofMul (toPrincipalIdeal R K x)) =
      (OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).principalDivisor (Additive.ofMul x)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdealDivisor_asIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
lemma fractionalIdealDivisor_asIdeal (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    fractionalIdealDivisor R K
        (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 (v.asIdeal : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)
          (FractionalIdeal.coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr v.ne_bot))) = ofPoint v

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdealDivisor_injective
